title: Umami Crisp Australian Tadka Frittata
description: A post-workout ovo-vegetarian-friendly dish that combines the flavors of Australia with the savory goodness of garlic sauce and tadka.

ingredients.name: tadka oil
ingredients.notes: use a neutral oil like canola or grapeseed

instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of tadka oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, shredded cheddar cheese, chopped parsley, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Add the grated ginger and whisk until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked onion and garlic mixture in the skillet.
Sprinkle the remaining 1 tablespoon of tadka oil over the top of the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
